title: Sotorasib, Panitumumab and FOLFIRI Versus FOLFIRI With or Without Bevacizumab-awwb in Treatment-naïve Subjects With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer With KRAS p.G12C Mutation (CodeBreaK 301)
official: Phase 3 Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label, Active-controlled Study of Sotorasib, Panitumumab and FOLFIRI Versus FOLFIRI With or Without Bevacizumab-awwb for Treatment-naïve Subjects With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer With KRAS p.G12C Mutation (CodeBreaK 301)
summary: Main objective: To compare progression free survival (PFS) in treatment-naïve subjects with KRAS p.G12C mutated metastaticcolorectal cancer (mCRC) between the experimental arm and the control arm
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Pathologically documented metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma
2. Central confirmation of KRAS p.G12C mutation
3. Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 criteria. Lesions previously radiated are not considered measurable unless they have progressed after radiation
4. Age  ≥ 18 years (or  ≥ legal age within the country if it is more than 18 years)
5. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of ≤ 1
6. Life expectancy of > 6 months, in the opinion of the investigator
7. Adequate hematologic and end organ function
8. Ability to take oral medications and willing to record daily adherence to investigational product
9. Central laboratory detection of KRAS p.G12C mutation
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active, untreated brain metastases
2. Leptomeningeal disease
3. Previous treatment with a KRAS p.G12C inhibitor
4. Subject has required a dose reduction or dose delay of either 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) or irinotecan in any prior chemotherapy regimen in the past for toxicity, to the investigator's knowledge
5. History of interstitial pneumonitis or pulmonary fibrosis or evidence of interstitial pneumonitis or pulmonary fibrosis on baseline CT scan
